user_problem: Teams leave obsolete feature flags in place because removal dependencies are unclear.
unique_output: A retirement checklist mapping supplied flag states to references, cleanup order, rollback boundary, and evidence gaps.
test_case: Given one flag referenced by application code, configuration, and tests, produce an ordered cleanup plan without performing removal.
overlap_to_check: Release, migration, scope-change, and handover workflows.
specific_guardrail: No flag removal or live rollout advice without supplied state and policy. List unresolved usage references and proposed dependency order, never prove universal safe deletion.
